news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.85 (vs ₹3.97 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.85 (down from ₹3.97 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹2.14b (up 33% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹64.4m (down 2.9% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 3.0% (down from 4.1% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.

news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's interest payments are not well covered by earnings. Net interest cover: 2.3x This is considered a major risk. If the company is unable to fund interest repayments on its debt through profits, it may be forced into reducing its debt burden through selling assets, undertaking a potentially costly capital raising or even into bankruptcy in the worst case scenario. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.3x net interest cover). Earnings have declined by 6.7% per year over the past 5 years. Minor Risks Paying a dividend despite having no free cash flows. Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.7% average weekly change). Market cap is less than US$100m (₹1.18b market cap,

news.title: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited announced that at the bord meeting held on May 19, 2026, Recommended final dividend of INR 1 (10%) per equity share of INR10 each for the Financial Year 2025-26, subject to the approval of shareholders at the upcoming Annual General Meeting of the Company. The Company has fixed May, 29, 2026 as the Record Date for determining the entitlement of Members for the proposed Final Dividend.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 22%
news.body: After last week's 22% share price gain to ₹85.37, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 19.3x. Average trailing P/E is 17x in the Construction industry in India.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 3 experienced directors. 5 highly experienced directors. Independent Non-Executive Director Ranajit Mondal was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2021. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
